about: St. Catharines is the largest city in the Niagara Region, between Lake Ontario and the Niagara Escarpment. It is a garden city with the Welland Canal running through it and vineyards on the surrounding bench. Brock University sits on the escarpment above the city. About 140,000 people live in St. Catharines.
